newsitem.title: KENYA: EU boosts grants to three Africa states.
newsitem.headline: EU boosts grants to three Africa states.

text.p: European Commissioner Joao de Deus Pinheiro said on Tuesday the European Union increased its grants to three African states by between 10 and 45 percent.
Pinheiro, who made trips over the last two weeks to Ethiopia, Kenya and Uganda, said he signed national grants and one regional grant for the next five years worth a total of 935 Ecus ($794 million).
Asked whether EU aid was tied to human rights improvements, Pinheiro said:

"When you mention human rights you have got always to put things in perspective in the sense that things appear to be sometimes not so perfect in one spot but then when you realise what is going on in not so far away countries you realise that things there are much worse."
He said one had to be pragmatic in making funding decision.
"You cannot isolate human rights from the basic rights of the citizen for food, shelter, opportunities...all these things are important in assessing the progress of a country," he said.

He said the EU would continue to fund the organisation for elections in Zaire despite civil war and said he hoped by July the Kivu province could also take part in the polls. Rebels seized Kivu in October in their fight to topple the Zaire government. ($1=1.1775 ECU)
